Christa Karmi is a higher ranked soldier of the UFS.



Personality
She is known as the Ice Witch, and although she usually treats those around her with a harsh attitude, her desire to pray for the safety of her subordinates and friends is stronger than anyone else's. She often punishes soldiers who play too many pranks with an iron fist, but this is in order to instill her lessons in them in order to survive on the battlefield. Although she is strict with her son, Marco, she gives all the love she can to him and shows him the kind demeanor typical of a mother.

It's been a while since her boyfriend was killed in the war, and she sometimes feels like masturbating, but she's too busy with her work and son to satisfy her desires, which leaves her a little bit frustrated.

Appearance
She has short turquoise hair and turquoise eyes.

History
Background
Krista works as a human soldier and at times squad leader in the UFS.

She is a technical staff member but has experience as a mercenary in her home country, and she is also quite skilled in weapon handling and martial arts. She was a mercenary when she belonged to the UFS, but when she became pregnant with her son, Marco, she returned to her original role as a staff member. The man who was supposed to be her husband was killed in battle, and Marco is her only family.

She now cares for Marco on her own, and is also busy with her weapon testing of the Gravity Gun.

Timeline TABA
Appears only in "What If" event.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Gravity Gun

Special Weapon: Gun can create destructive gravity. Crushes objects.
